name: news.cmbs/cmbs-news
title: cmbs.news: CMBS loan data
description: Loan-level CMBS data from SEC filings: loans, trusts, CUSIPs, distress index, tenants, comps.

tools.name: search_loans
tools.description: Returns loans in public CMBS trusts that match your filters, largest balance first unless sorted, with the total match count and total balance. Use it to find a loan or property by name, address, city or ZIP, or to screen by status, type, state, metro, tenant, maturity, balance, coverage, occupancy, rate, vintage, servicer, originator or trust. All filters are optional and combine; no match returns an empty list and a total of 0. Use get_loan for one loan's full record and tenant_exposure to rank tenants.

q.description: Word starts in the property name, street address, ZIP, city, metro, state, property type or trust name, e.g. "times square", "825 Eighth Avenue" or "houston office"

status.description: Loan condition, or a Schedule AL status as filed: foreclosure, reo (real estate owned), forbearance or extended (a modification dated in the last 24 months)

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or several with commas between, e.g. "FL,TX"

cbsa.description: Census CBSA metro code, e.g. 35620 for New York

city.description: Whole city name, optionally with state, e.g. "Houston" or "Houston, TX"

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code of the property, e.g. "10001"

tenant.description: A tenant named among the three largest, e.g. "Walgreens"

min_occupancy.description: Minimum latest occupancy, as a fraction or percent: 0.8 or 80

max_occupancy.description: Maximum latest occupancy, as a fraction or percent

min_rate.description: Minimum current interest rate, as a fraction or percent: 0.05 or 5

max_rate.description: Maximum current interest rate, as a fraction or percent

min_debt_yield.description: Minimum debt yield on the latest NOI, as a fraction or percent: 0.1 or 10

max_debt_yield.description: Maximum debt yield on the latest NOI, as a fraction or percent: 0.08 or 8

built_after.description: Property built in or after this year, e.g. 2016; loans with one property only

built_before.description: Property built in or before this year

interest_only.description: How the loan pays from its terms at origination: full (interest only for the whole term), partial (for part of it), any (either) or none (amortizing)

special_servicer.description: Trust's special servicer: finds loans in trusts whose general special servicer is this name, or part of it, e.g. "Rialto". A given loan may be serviced by someone else

originator.description: Originator, or part of the name, e.g. "Wells Fargo"

trust.description: Only loans in this trust, by slug, e.g. "benchmark-2018-b8"

limit.description: Results per call: up to 10 without a key, 100 with one

offset.description: For paging: without a key a search stops at the first 25 results; with a key it pages through everything

tools.name: get_loan
tools.description: Returns one loan's record by its slug: terms, status, coverage, occupancy, the three largest tenants, watch flags, every trust holding a piece, and the special servicer's comment facts, appraisal reduction and advances. The special servicer is named only when one trust holds the whole loan and its report names one. termsAtIssuance has its terms from the prospectus, as of issuance: appraised value, LTV, underwritten DSCR and debt yield, lockbox and other debt. Get the slug from search_loans; use get_trust for the deal. Fields that need a key are named in proFields.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

tools.name: get_loan_parties
tools.description: Returns the guarantors, named parties and contacts that SEC filings give for one loan (prospectus Annex A-1 and the trust's 10-D), each with a link to its filing. Use it after get_loan when asked who stands behind a loan. Without a key it returns only how many are on file.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

tools.name: get_loan_history
tools.description: Returns one loan's monthly reports back to its first filing (late 2016 at the earliest): balance, payment status, special servicing, workout strategy, modification, coverage and occupancy. Use it to see how a loan reached its current state. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed; the loan page on cmbs.news shows the last 12 monthly reports.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

tools.name: get_loan_servicer
tools.description: Returns what each trust's monthly trustee report (Form 10-D) said about one loan, month by month, for about the last year: the special servicer's comment facts with a short excerpt, resolution strategy, transfer and return dates, foreclosure, bankruptcy and REO dates, appraisal values and reductions, advances and modifications, and what changed from the previous report. Use it after get_loan to see what happened to a loan and what changed this month. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

tools.name: get_other_loans_by_name
tools.description: Returns the other loans whose SEC filings print a guarantor or sponsor name this loan's prospectus prints, largest first, with balance, payment status, maturity and the filing behind each row. Same printed name in SEC filings, as of issuance: it does not show that they are the same person or company, so do not say that it does. Not a consumer report. Use it after get_loan_parties. name narrows the answer to one nameId, for paging. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed, and no names.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name.description: A nameId from a previous answer, to page that one name's loans

limit.description: Loans per name: default 10, up to 100

tools.name: get_loan_companies
tools.description: Returns the state business records filed under the name of each company or fund a loan's prospectus names as guarantor or sponsor (entity number, status, formation, registered agent, addresses, officers or managers where the state publishes them, each with its source) and the people tied to it, with whether a business email, mobile number or LinkedIn is on file. A record matches on the same name, word for word: it does not prove it is the company the filing means. Use reveal_contact for one person's contact details. Without a key it returns a notice that a key is needed.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

tools.name: reveal_contact
tools.description: Returns one person's business email, mobile number and LinkedIn profile, by a person id from get_loan_companies. Calling or texting the number is subject to the TCPA and Do Not Call rules, which the answer repeats. Each new person opened counts against the account's monthly allowance (the same person again that month is free), and the answer says how many are left. Business use only; not a consumer report; no extracting or resale. Without a key it returns a tool error that says so.

person.description: A person id from get_loan_companies (16 hex characters)

tools.name: get_trust
tools.description: Returns one CMBS trust (deal) by slug or name fragment: balance and distress, parties (master and special servicer, directing certificateholder, operating advisor, trustee), every certificate class with CUSIP, coupon, balance, losses and credit support, and liquidated loans with loss severity. Use list_trusts to find a trust by name; use search_loans with trust set to a slug for the trust's loans.

trust.description: Trust slug like "benchmark-2018-b8" or a name fragment like "BANK 2019-BNK16"

tools.name: list_trusts
tools.description: Lists public CMBS trusts, most distressed first (share of balance delinquent or with the special servicer), optionally filtered by a name fragment such as Benchmark or 2021. Use it to find a trust's slug or to see which deals are most distressed; use get_trust for one deal. No match returns an empty list.

limit.description: Up to 25 without a key, 400 with one

tools.name: distress_index
tools.description: Returns the cmbs.news distress index: delinquency, special-servicing and matured-unpaid rates (balance-weighted, every trust that files a loan-level tape; the headline view adds this month with the older trusts read from their 10-D reports), this month's transfers in and out of special servicing, and rates by property type. Set view for one part, or for more: vintage, state, series (every month since December 2016) or seasoning. Open data under CC BY 4.0. Use it for market-wide rates and trends; use wire for the individual loans that changed this month.

view.description: Which part of the index to return. Leave out for the latest rates, this month's flows and rates by property type. vintage also has type by vintage; series is the monthly history; seasoning is how the age of the pool moves the rates

tools.name: wire
tools.description: Returns the latest monthly Wire: loans transferred to or returned from special servicing, newly delinquent, moved deeper into delinquency, new appraisal reductions, liquidations with losses and special servicer updates, largest first. Use section to fetch one list. Use it for what changed this month; use distress_index for rates and trends and search_loans for a loan's current state. Comment excerpts are included only with a key.

limit.description: Items per section: default 10 without a key and 25 with one; up to 25 without a key and 400 with one

tools.name: tenant_exposure
tools.description: Lists the loans where a named tenant is among the three largest at the property, with balance, status, coverage and, where it is the largest tenant, the lease end. With no tenant it lists the tenants with the most CMBS exposure. Use it to measure exposure to one tenant; use search_loans with tenant set to filter a wider search. No match returns an empty list.

limit.description: Tenants or loans listed: up to 25 without a key, 400 with one

tools.name: comps
tools.description: Returns single-property CMBS loans as operating comparables: revenue, operating expenses, NOI (each per square foot), expense ratio, occupancy, DSCR and valuations, filtered by property type, metro, state, size and year built, with medians over every match. Use it for market operating benchmarks; use search_loans for loan status and terms.

limit.description: Up to 25 without a key, 400 with one; the medians always cover every match

tools.name: find_cusip
tools.description: Returns one certificate class by its 9-character CUSIP: its trust, coupon, original and current balance, principal paid, realized losses and credit support from the latest trustee report. Use it when the user gives a CUSIP; use get_trust to see all of a trust's classes. An unknown CUSIP returns an error.

tools.name: sasb_clo_deals
tools.description: Lists single-borrower (SASB) CMBS and CRE CLO deals named in public SEC filings, newest first: issuer, ABS-15G filing date, sponsor, loan and property counts, and filing links. With deal set to a deal name (its shelf and series as the SEC filing prints them) it returns that deal and, for a CRE CLO whose sponsor filed the indenture, the closing-date loan list. Use it for private deals, which file no monthly reports; use get_trust for public trusts. Without a key it says whether a named deal is on file, with its SEC filing and date, and otherwise how many deals are on file.

deal.description: The deal name, as its SEC filing prints the shelf and series (a code name or a former name also works), or an id from a previous answer

q.description: Word starts in the deal, depositor or sponsor name, e.g. "BX" or "TRTX"

year.description: Year of the first ABS-15G filing, e.g. "2026"

limit.description: Deals per call: default 100, up to 400 with a key

tools.name: about
tools.description: Returns the coverage and currency of the data: trust and loan counts, as-of and filing dates, the headline index, the limits with and without a key, licence and links to the docs, OpenAPI and changelog. Use it to answer how current or complete the data is, or what limits apply.
